text:
- [RCTS.1.2.2] **`id`** — the fixture's id ([RCTS.1.1]), equal to its
  file name without `.json`. Where the two disagree the file name is
  authoritative, because every citation of a fixture names its path
  ([STYL.5.2.8]). A harness must fail a fixture whose `id` disagrees with
  its file name.
